title: Open each area to see when to use it
prompt: Select an area to reveal what it is for.

hotspots.label: Forum
hotspots.detail: Start a discussion to exchange ideas and ask questions. Search first; your question may already have an answer.

hotspots.label: Events
hotspots.detail: Glean Support runs a monthly live troubleshooting session on the second Thursday of each month. The Glean Product Team hosts monthly product updates on the fourth Thursday. Replays of earlier events are available on demand.

hotspots.label: Academy
hotspots.detail: Glean Academy offers courses to master new topics.

hotspots.label: Feedback and Ideas
hotspots.detail: Submit feature requests and product feedback on the Feedback and Ideas board.

hotspots.label: Admin Hub
hotspots.detail: The Admin Hub is a restricted space for customer administrators.
